messages:
elaine: Quick sync: design follow-up on swapping project-wide API keys for fine-grained capability tokens. Goal: limit blast radius for machine creds while keeping migration friction low.
omar: High-level question: do we keep RBAC for humans and translate to capabilities for machines?
elaine: Yes. Humans keep RBAC. When machines need privileges we mint capability tokens mapped from role bundles. This avoids changing human-facing UX.
tomas: For token shape, propose compact JWS with cap claim array, exp, iss, kid, jti optional. No opaque blobs for easier gateway verification.
keiko: How about background jobs/CI that can't rotate frequently? We should allow long-lived worker-role tokens with strict auditing and rotation policy and an opt-in console flag.
elaine: Agreed. Two issuance flows: short-lived delegated tokens (5-15m) for request-time use; long-lived audited tokens for CI with 90-day rotation enforced.
omar: Enforcement: Gateway should validate JWS and capability claims. Services may trust gateway or locally verify if extra checks needed. Gateway-first reduces duplication.
tomas: For critical ops (refunds, account deletion) require single-use or single-use-with-nonce tokens. Add jti to revoke used tokens.
keiko: Migration phases: (1) Add mint endpoint + SDK helper; (2) Opt-in endpoints accept both key types and emit telemetry; (3) Warn header when project-key used; (4) Enforce capability tokens.
elaine: Telemetry: metric auth.credential_type{endpoint,credential_type}. Alert if >3% of sensitive-endpoint traffic uses project_key after warning window.
omar: Backcompat helpers: console "exchange key->capability" flow and CLI `redwood auth exchange --from Kxxx --cap models:write --ttl 3600`.
tomas: On-prem: allow customer-managed signing keys (upload public key) and local mint service. Document emergency revocation via key bundle rotation and revocation list sync.
keiko: SDK should provide capability builder + transparent refresh. Example: `client.issueCapability({resources:['models/123'], actions:['write'], ttl:600})`.
elaine: Draft RFC checklist: API shapes, gateway validation snippet, migration playbook for SRE, telemetry queries, and runbook for rotation failures.
deploy-bot: Deployed canary: auth-mint v0.3 -> staging at 2024-06-15T11:12:00Z :rocket:
omar: Security items: threat model for token theft, replay protection, key rotation test matrix.
keiko: OK. Elaine will file RFC by Tue with concrete curl examples and sample guardian policies. I'll loop in Solutions + SRE.
elaine: Will do, posting link here when ready. :thumbsup:
